# UI recipes

Each recipe is code from the kit's `examples/gallery`, which builds for the board and the emulator and passes `ui_lint` on every page, so the code here compiles there. The types the recipes share (`recipe_pick_cb_t`, `tile_t`, `confirm_cb_t`) are declared in the gallery's `main/recipes.h`, and the app loop uses the gallery's own `main.c`. Copy what you need into the product and rename freely. Call every function with the LVGL lock held: from an LVGL callback, or between `lcd349_ui_lock()` and `lcd349_ui_unlock()`.

To see them all: build and run `examples/gallery`. PWR's short press moves to the next page; BOOT and touch work each page.

| Recipe | Use it for |
|---|---|
| [Shared helpers](#shared-helpers) | colours, the two bands, labels, panels, buttons without press animation, the focus ring |
| [Status bar](#status-bar) | the screen's title, Wi-Fi, battery and the time |
| [List](#list) | choosing one of a few items, by touch or by buttons |
| [Detail card](#detail-card) | one item's title and text, with Back |
| [Menu tiles](#menu-tiles) | a handful of destinations along the long axis |
| [Confirm dialog](#confirm-dialog) | asking before an irreversible action |
| [Toast](#toast) | a brief result message |
| [Hold to confirm](#hold-to-confirm) | approving with a button hold, with the visibility guard |
| [Setup screen](#setup-screen) | a few settings, saved to storage |
| [The app loop](#the-app-loop) | wiring buttons through the classifier to the screen |

## Shared helpers

The recipes share one look: a dark background, white and light grey text well over the contrast rule, one accent colour, two bands, and two font sizes. Sizes come from `lcd349_board.h` (`LCD349_LCD_W`, `LCD349_RULE_TOUCH_TARGET_PX`), never from copied numbers. Panels aren't clickable (LVGL makes every container clickable by default), and buttons change state at once instead of animating.

```c
/* Colours: a dark background with text well over the 4.5:1 contrast rule. */
#define UI_BG 0x0B1622
#define UI_SURFACE 0x1B2B40
#define UI_ACCENT 0x1565C0
#define UI_TEXT 0xFFFFFF
#define UI_MUTED 0xB8C4D0
#define UI_DANGER 0xB71C1C
#define UI_GOOD 0x2E7D32

/* Two bands: a status bar on top, the body below it. */
#define UI_STATUS_H 24
#define UI_BODY_H (LCD349_LCD_H - UI_STATUS_H)
#define UI_TARGET LCD349_RULE_TOUCH_TARGET_PX /* the smallest touch target */
#define UI_PAD 12

#define UI_FONT (&lv_font_montserrat_14)
#define UI_FONT_LARGE (&lv_font_montserrat_20)

/* A label in one of the two fonts. */
lv_obj_t *ui_label(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *text, const lv_font_t *font, uint32_t color);

/* A plain container: no border, padding, scrolling or clicks. */
lv_obj_t *ui_panel(lv_obj_t *parent, int w, int h, uint32_t bg);

/* A button with a centred label, at least UI_TARGET in both directions. */
lv_obj_t *ui_button(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *text, int w, int h, lv_event_cb_t on_click, void *ctx);

/* Every frame is a full-panel flush on this board, so presses change state
 * at once instead of animating. (A NULL transition crashes LVGL 9.6.) */
void ui_no_press_animation(lv_obj_t *obj);

/* The ring around the object the buttons have stepped to. */
void ui_set_focus(lv_obj_t *obj, bool focused);

lv_obj_t *ui_label(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *text, const lv_font_t *font, uint32_t color)
{
    lv_obj_t *l = lv_label_create(parent);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(l, font, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(l, lv_color_hex(color), 0);
    lv_label_set_text(l, text);
    return l;
}

lv_obj_t *ui_panel(lv_obj_t *parent, int w, int h, uint32_t bg)
{
    lv_obj_t *p = lv_obj_create(parent);
    lv_obj_set_size(p, w, h);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(p, lv_color_hex(bg), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(p, LV_OPA_COVER, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(p, 0, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(p, 0, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_pad_all(p, 0, 0);
    lv_obj_set_scrollable(p, false);
    lv_obj_set_clickable(p, false); /* LVGL makes containers clickable; a panel only holds things */
    return p;
}

void ui_no_press_animation(lv_obj_t *obj)
{
    static const lv_style_prop_t no_props[] = {LV_STYLE_PROP_INV};
    static lv_style_transition_dsc_t none;
    static bool ready;
    if (!ready) {
        lv_style_transition_dsc_init(&none, no_props, lv_anim_path_linear, 0, 0, NULL);
        ready = true;
    }
    lv_obj_set_style_transition(obj, &none, LV_STATE_DEFAULT);
    lv_obj_set_style_transition(obj, &none, LV_STATE_PRESSED);
}

lv_obj_t *ui_button(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *text, int w, int h, lv_event_cb_t on_click, void *ctx)
{
    lv_obj_t *b = lv_button_create(parent);
    lv_obj_set_size(b, LV_MAX(w, UI_TARGET), LV_MAX(h, UI_TARGET));
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(b, lv_color_hex(UI_ACCENT), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(b, 0, 0);
    ui_no_press_animation(b);
    if (on_click) {
        lv_obj_add_event_cb(b, on_click, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, ctx);
    }
    lv_obj_t *l = ui_label(b, text, UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_center(l);
    return b;
}

void ui_set_focus(lv_obj_t *obj, bool focused)
{
    lv_obj_set_style_outline_width(obj, focused ? 3 : 0, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_outline_color(obj, lv_color_hex(UI_TEXT), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_outline_pad(obj, focused ? 2 : 0, 0);
}
```

## Status bar

The top band. Refresh it from a 1 s `lv_timer` (timers run on the UI task, with the lock held). It sets the label only when the text changes: an unchanged label costs no flush.

```c
/* The top band: the screen's title on the left; Wi-Fi, battery and the time
 * on the right. Refresh it from a 1 s lv_timer; it only redraws what changed,
 * because every change costs a full-frame flush. */
typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *title, *right;
    char shown[48];
} status_bar_t;

static void status_bar_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

lv_obj_t *status_bar_create(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *title)
{
    lv_obj_t *bar = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_STATUS_H, UI_SURFACE);
    status_bar_t *s = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *s);
    s->title = ui_label(bar, title, UI_FONT, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_align(s->title, LV_ALIGN_LEFT_MID, UI_PAD, 0);
    s->right = ui_label(bar, "", UI_FONT, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_align(s->right, LV_ALIGN_RIGHT_MID, -UI_PAD, 0);
    lv_obj_set_user_data(bar, s);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(bar, status_bar_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, s);
    status_bar_refresh(bar);
    return bar;
}

void status_bar_refresh(lv_obj_t *bar)
{
    status_bar_t *s = lv_obj_get_user_data(bar);
    uint16_t mv = 0;
    uint8_t pct = 0;
    lcd349_battery_read(&mv, &pct);
    const char *battery = pct > 80 ? LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_FULL : pct > 55 ? LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_3 : pct > 30 ? LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_2
                        : pct > 10 ? LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_1 : LV_SYMBOL_BATTERY_EMPTY;
    lcd349_wifi_status_t wifi = {0};
    lcd349_wifi_status(&wifi);
    int64_t now = 0;
    lcd349_rtc_get(&now);
    time_t t = (time_t)now;
    struct tm tm;
    gmtime_r(&t, &tm);
    char text[48];
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%s  %s %u%%  %02d:%02d", wifi.state == LCD349_WIFI_CONNECTED ? LV_SYMBOL_WIFI : "",
             battery, pct, tm.tm_hour, tm.tm_min);
    if (strcmp(text, s->shown) != 0) { /* unchanged text costs no flush */
        lv_label_set_text(s->right, text);
        snprintf(s->shown, sizeof s->shown, "%s", text);
    }
}
```

## List

About three rows show at once. A tap opens a row; BOOT's short press moves the selection and a hold opens it. The selection is filled with the accent colour, because an outline is clipped at the screen's edges. Scrolling snaps to rows, without momentum, and a tap doesn't scroll the list.

```c
/* Rows that a tap opens, or that BOOT steps through (short press) and opens
 * (hold). The list scrolls without momentum and snaps to whole rows, because
 * kinetic scrolling judders when every frame is a full-panel flush. Rows are
 * tagged "list-row": dense rows may be a little under the touch target size,
 * since a row is as wide as the screen. The selected row is filled with the
 * accent colour: an outline would be clipped at the screen's edges. */
#define LIST_ROW_H 48

typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *rows[16];
    int n, selected;
    recipe_pick_cb_t on_open;
    void *ctx;
} list_t;

static void list_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

static void list_row_clicked(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_obj_t *row = lv_event_get_current_target_obj(e);
    list_t *l = lv_event_get_user_data(e);
    l->on_open((int)lv_obj_get_index(row), l->ctx);
}

lv_obj_t *list_create(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *const *items, int n, recipe_pick_cb_t on_open, void *ctx)
{
    lv_obj_t *list = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);
    lv_obj_set_scrollable(list, true);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_dir(list, LV_DIR_VER);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_momentum(list, false);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_snap_y(list, LV_SCROLL_SNAP_START);
    lv_obj_set_scrollbar_mode(list, LV_SCROLLBAR_MODE_OFF);
    lv_obj_set_flex_flow(list, LV_FLEX_FLOW_COLUMN);
    lv_obj_set_style_pad_row(list, 0, 0);
    list_t *l = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *l);
    l->n = LV_MIN(n, 16);
    l->on_open = on_open;
    l->ctx = ctx;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) {
        lv_obj_t *row = ui_panel(list, LCD349_LCD_W, LIST_ROW_H, i % 2 ? UI_BG : UI_SURFACE);
        lv_obj_set_clickable(row, true);
        lv_obj_set_snappable(row, true);
        lv_obj_set_scroll_on_focus(row, false); /* LVGL's default: a tap would move the list */
        lcd349_ui_tag(row, "list-row");
        lv_obj_add_event_cb(row, list_row_clicked, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, l);
        lv_obj_t *text = ui_label(row, items[i], UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
        lv_obj_set_width(text, LCD349_LCD_W - 2 * UI_PAD);
        lv_label_set_long_mode(text, LV_LABEL_LONG_MODE_DOTS);
        lv_obj_align(text, LV_ALIGN_LEFT_MID, UI_PAD, 0);
        l->rows[i] = row;
    }
    lv_obj_set_user_data(list, l);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(list, list_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, l);
    list_step(list, 0);
    return list;
}

static void list_paint(list_t *l, int i, bool selected)
{
    uint32_t bg = selected ? UI_ACCENT : i % 2 ? UI_BG : UI_SURFACE;
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(l->rows[i], lv_color_hex(bg), 0);
}

void list_step(lv_obj_t *list, int delta)
{
    list_t *l = lv_obj_get_user_data(list);
    list_paint(l, l->selected, false);
    l->selected = (l->selected + delta + l->n) % l->n;
    list_paint(l, l->selected, true);
    lv_obj_scroll_to_view(l->rows[l->selected], LV_ANIM_OFF);
}

void list_open_selected(lv_obj_t *list)
{
    list_t *l = lv_obj_get_user_data(list);
    l->on_open(l->selected, l->ctx);
}
```

## Detail card

The title runs to "..." on one line, the body wraps over two and ends in "...", and Back sits on the right, full height. Deliberate truncation passes `ui_lint`; text that runs off doesn't.

```c
/* A detail card: a large title, a body that wraps over two lines and ends in
 * "..." if it's longer (deliberate truncation passes lint; clipped text
 * doesn't), and a Back button on the right where a thumb reaches it. */
lv_obj_t *card_create(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *title, const char *body, lv_event_cb_t on_back, void *ctx)
{
    const int back_w = 120;
    const int text_w = LCD349_LCD_W - back_w - 3 * UI_PAD;
    lv_obj_t *card = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);

    lv_obj_t *t = ui_label(card, title, UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_set_width(t, text_w);
    lv_label_set_long_mode(t, LV_LABEL_LONG_MODE_DOTS);
    lv_obj_set_pos(t, UI_PAD, UI_PAD);

    lv_obj_t *b = ui_label(card, body, UI_FONT, UI_MUTED);
    lv_obj_set_size(b, text_w, 2 * lv_font_get_line_height(UI_FONT));
    lv_label_set_long_mode(b, LV_LABEL_LONG_MODE_DOTS);
    lv_obj_set_pos(b, UI_PAD, UI_PAD + lv_font_get_line_height(UI_FONT_LARGE) + 8);

    lv_obj_t *back = ui_button(card, LV_SYMBOL_LEFT " Back", back_w, UI_BODY_H - 2 * UI_PAD, on_back, ctx);
    lv_obj_align(back, LV_ALIGN_RIGHT_MID, -UI_PAD, 0);
    return card;
}
```

## Menu tiles

Big tiles along the long axis; the fifth peeks in from the edge. A swipe moves a tile at a time. BOOT steps the focus ring and a hold opens; a tap opens the tile tapped and makes it the selection.

```c
/* A horizontal menu: big tiles along the screen's long axis, which a swipe
 * scrolls a tile at a time (snapping, no momentum). BOOT steps the focus and
 * a hold opens; a tap opens the tile tapped. */
#define TILE_W 140
#define TILE_H (UI_BODY_H - 2 * UI_PAD)

typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *tiles[12];
    int n, selected;
    recipe_pick_cb_t on_open;
    void *ctx;
} tiles_t;

static void tiles_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

static void tile_clicked(lv_event_t *e)
{
    tiles_t *t = lv_event_get_user_data(e);
    int i = (int)lv_obj_get_index(lv_event_get_current_target_obj(e));
    ui_set_focus(t->tiles[t->selected], false); /* the tapped tile becomes the selection */
    t->selected = i;
    ui_set_focus(t->tiles[i], true);
    t->on_open(i, t->ctx);
}

lv_obj_t *tiles_create(lv_obj_t *parent, const tile_t *items, int n, recipe_pick_cb_t on_open, void *ctx)
{
    lv_obj_t *row = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);
    lv_obj_set_scrollable(row, true);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_dir(row, LV_DIR_HOR);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_momentum(row, false);
    lv_obj_set_scroll_snap_x(row, LV_SCROLL_SNAP_CENTER);
    lv_obj_set_scrollbar_mode(row, LV_SCROLLBAR_MODE_OFF);
    lv_obj_set_flex_flow(row, LV_FLEX_FLOW_ROW);
    lv_obj_set_flex_align(row, LV_FLEX_ALIGN_START, LV_FLEX_ALIGN_CENTER, LV_FLEX_ALIGN_CENTER);
    lv_obj_set_style_pad_column(row, UI_PAD, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_pad_hor(row, UI_PAD, 0);
    tiles_t *t = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *t);
    t->n = LV_MIN(n, 12);
    t->on_open = on_open;
    t->ctx = ctx;
    for (int i = 0; i < t->n; i++) {
        lv_obj_t *tile = lv_button_create(row);
        lv_obj_set_size(tile, TILE_W, TILE_H);
        lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(tile, lv_color_hex(UI_SURFACE), 0);
        lv_obj_set_style_shadow_width(tile, 0, 0);
        lv_obj_set_snappable(tile, true);
        lv_obj_set_scroll_on_focus(tile, false); /* LVGL's default: a tap would move the row */
        ui_no_press_animation(tile);
        lv_obj_add_event_cb(tile, tile_clicked, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, t);
        lv_obj_t *icon = ui_label(tile, items[i].symbol, UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
        lv_obj_align(icon, LV_ALIGN_CENTER, 0, -16);
        lv_obj_t *label = ui_label(tile, items[i].label, UI_FONT, UI_TEXT);
        lv_obj_align(label, LV_ALIGN_CENTER, 0, 20);
        t->tiles[i] = tile;
    }
    lv_obj_set_user_data(row, t);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(row, tiles_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, t);
    ui_set_focus(t->tiles[0], true);
    return row;
}

void tiles_step(lv_obj_t *row, int delta)
{
    tiles_t *t = lv_obj_get_user_data(row);
    ui_set_focus(t->tiles[t->selected], false);
    t->selected = (t->selected + delta + t->n) % t->n;
    ui_set_focus(t->tiles[t->selected], true);
    lv_obj_scroll_to_view(t->tiles[t->selected], LV_ANIM_OFF);
}

void tiles_open_selected(lv_obj_t *row)
{
    tiles_t *t = lv_obj_get_user_data(row);
    t->on_open(t->selected, t->ctx);
}
```

## Confirm dialog

A modal on the top layer. Its full-screen backdrop takes every tap and dims what's below, and `ui_lint` knows nothing under it can be pressed. Cancel has the focus first, so a stray hold never confirms.

```c
/* A modal question on the top layer. A full-screen backdrop takes every tap
 * (and dims the screen), so nothing below can be pressed by accident. Cancel
 * has the focus first: a stray BOOT hold must never confirm. BOOT steps
 * between the two buttons and a hold chooses; a tap chooses directly. */
typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *backdrop, *buttons[2];
    int focus; /* 0 = cancel, 1 = the action */
    confirm_cb_t done;
    void *ctx;
} confirm_t;

static void confirm_finish(confirm_t *c, bool confirmed)
{
    confirm_cb_t done = c->done;
    void *ctx = c->ctx;
    lv_obj_delete(c->backdrop); /* frees c */
    done(confirmed, ctx);
}

static void confirm_clicked(lv_event_t *e)
{
    confirm_t *c = lv_event_get_user_data(e);
    confirm_finish(c, lv_event_get_current_target_obj(e) == c->buttons[1]);
}

static void confirm_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

lv_obj_t *confirm_show(const char *question, const char *action, confirm_cb_t done, void *ctx)
{
    confirm_t *c = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *c);
    c->done = done;
    c->ctx = ctx;
    c->backdrop = ui_panel(lv_layer_top(), LCD349_LCD_W, LCD349_LCD_H, 0x000000);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(c->backdrop, LV_OPA_70, 0);
    lv_obj_set_clickable(c->backdrop, true); /* swallows taps outside the dialog */
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(c->backdrop, confirm_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, c);

    lv_obj_t *box = ui_panel(c->backdrop, LCD349_LCD_W - 4 * UI_PAD, LCD349_LCD_H - 4 * UI_PAD, UI_SURFACE);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(box, 8, 0);
    lv_obj_center(box);
    lv_obj_t *q = ui_label(box, question, UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_set_width(q, LCD349_LCD_W - 6 * UI_PAD);
    lv_label_set_long_mode(q, LV_LABEL_LONG_MODE_DOTS);
    lv_obj_align(q, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, UI_PAD, UI_PAD);

    const int bw = 180;
    c->buttons[0] = ui_button(box, "Cancel", bw, UI_TARGET, confirm_clicked, c);
    lv_obj_align(c->buttons[0], LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_LEFT, UI_PAD, -UI_PAD);
    c->buttons[1] = ui_button(box, action, bw, UI_TARGET, confirm_clicked, c);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(c->buttons[1], lv_color_hex(UI_DANGER), 0);
    lv_obj_align(c->buttons[1], LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_RIGHT, -UI_PAD, -UI_PAD);
    ui_set_focus(c->buttons[0], true);
    lv_obj_set_user_data(c->backdrop, c);
    return c->backdrop;
}

void confirm_step(lv_obj_t *dialog)
{
    confirm_t *c = lv_obj_get_user_data(dialog);
    ui_set_focus(c->buttons[c->focus], false);
    c->focus ^= 1;
    ui_set_focus(c->buttons[c->focus], true);
}

void confirm_choose(lv_obj_t *dialog)
{
    confirm_t *c = lv_obj_get_user_data(dialog);
    confirm_finish(c, c->focus == 1);
}
```

## Toast

One line at the bottom that removes itself; a new toast replaces the one showing. No fade.

```c
/* A one-line message at the bottom of the top layer that removes itself.
 * It appears and goes at once (no fade: animation costs a flush per frame),
 * takes no input, and a new toast replaces the one showing. */
static lv_obj_t *s_toast;

static void toast_expire(lv_timer_t *t)
{
    lv_obj_t *toast = lv_timer_get_user_data(t);
    if (toast == s_toast) {
        lv_obj_delete(s_toast);
        s_toast = NULL;
    }
}

static void toast_deleted(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_timer_delete(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
    if (lv_event_get_current_target_obj(e) == s_toast) {
        s_toast = NULL;
    }
}

void toast_show(const char *text, uint32_t ms)
{
    if (s_toast) {
        lv_obj_delete(s_toast);
    }
    s_toast = ui_panel(lv_layer_top(), LCD349_LCD_W - 8 * UI_PAD, 40, UI_SURFACE);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(s_toast, 8, 0);
    lv_obj_align(s_toast, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -UI_PAD);
    lv_obj_t *l = ui_label(s_toast, text, UI_FONT, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_set_width(l, LCD349_LCD_W - 10 * UI_PAD);
    lv_label_set_long_mode(l, LV_LABEL_LONG_MODE_DOTS);
    lv_obj_center(l);
    lv_timer_t *t = lv_timer_create(toast_expire, ms, s_toast);
    lv_timer_set_repeat_count(t, 1);
    lv_timer_set_auto_delete(t, false);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(s_toast, toast_deleted, LV_EVENT_DELETE, t);
}
```

## Hold to confirm

For actions that matter: a short press does nothing, a hold fills the bar, and the action happens the moment the hold completes. The visibility guard ignores a hold whose press began within 500 ms of the prompt appearing. Feed it from the app loop below.

```c
/* Hold to confirm: for actions that matter, a short press only shows how;
 * holding the button fills the bar, and the action happens when the hold
 * completes (the classifier's HOLD gesture). Touch never confirms.
 *
 * The visibility guard: a hold counts only if the button went down at least
 * 500 ms after the prompt appeared, so a press meant for the previous screen
 * can't approve this one. */
#define HOLD_GUARD_MS 500

typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *bar;
    lcd349_btn_t btn;
    uint32_t shown_ms;
    uint16_t shown_step;
} hold_t;

static void hold_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

lv_obj_t *hold_create(lv_obj_t *parent, const char *prompt, lcd349_btn_t btn)
{
    lv_obj_t *panel = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);
    hold_t *h = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *h);
    h->btn = btn;
    h->shown_ms = lcd349_time_ms();
    lv_obj_t *p = ui_label(panel, prompt, UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_align(p, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, UI_PAD, UI_PAD);
    h->bar = lv_bar_create(panel);
    lv_obj_set_size(h->bar, LCD349_LCD_W - 2 * UI_PAD, 32);
    lv_obj_align(h->bar, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -UI_PAD - 24);
    lv_bar_set_range(h->bar, 0, 10);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(h->bar, lv_color_hex(0x3A5270), LV_PART_MAIN); /* an empty track that still shows */
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(h->bar, lv_color_hex(UI_GOOD), LV_PART_INDICATOR);
    lv_obj_t *hint = ui_label(panel, "Release to cancel", UI_FONT, UI_MUTED);
    lv_obj_align(hint, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_LEFT, UI_PAD, -4);
    lv_obj_set_user_data(panel, h);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(panel, hold_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, h);
    return panel;
}

/* Call as the hold progresses (lcd349_classifier_hold_permille). The bar
 * moves in tenths, so a 1 s hold costs ten flushes, not fifty. */
void hold_progress(lv_obj_t *hold, uint16_t permille)
{
    hold_t *h = lv_obj_get_user_data(hold);
    uint16_t step = permille / 100;
    if (step != h->shown_step) {
        h->shown_step = step;
        lv_bar_set_value(h->bar, step, LV_ANIM_OFF);
    }
}

/* True when g completes a hold that should count. */
bool hold_accepts(lv_obj_t *hold, const lcd349_gesture_t *g)
{
    hold_t *h = lv_obj_get_user_data(hold);
    uint32_t pressed_at = g->t_ms - g->held_ms;
    return g->kind == LCD349_GESTURE_HOLD && g->btn == h->btn && g->level == 1 &&
           (int32_t)(pressed_at - h->shown_ms) >= HOLD_GUARD_MS;
}
```

## Setup screen

A few settings in one row, each a full touch target: brightness in tens with − and +, and sound as a switch sized up to the touch target. Changes apply at once and are saved with `lcd349_kv`, so they survive resets.

```c
/* A setup screen: settings in one row (no scrolling), each control a full
 * touch target. Brightness steps in tens with - and +; sound is a switch
 * sized up to the touch target. Changes apply at once and are saved with
 * lcd349_kv, so they survive a reset. */
typedef struct {
    lv_obj_t *value;
    uint8_t brightness;
} setup_t;

static void setup_free(lv_event_t *e)
{
    lv_free(lv_event_get_user_data(e));
}

static void setup_show(setup_t *s)
{
    lv_label_set_text_fmt(s->value, "%u%%", s->brightness);
}

static void brightness_step(lv_event_t *e, int delta)
{
    setup_t *s = lv_event_get_user_data(e);
    int b = LV_CLAMP(10, (int)s->brightness + delta, 100);
    s->brightness = (uint8_t)b;
    lcd349_backlight_set(s->brightness);
    lcd349_kv_set_blob("setup", "brightness", &s->brightness, 1);
    setup_show(s);
}

static void brightness_down(lv_event_t *e) { brightness_step(e, -10); }
static void brightness_up(lv_event_t *e) { brightness_step(e, +10); }

static void sound_changed(lv_event_t *e)
{
    uint8_t on = lv_obj_has_state(lv_event_get_current_target_obj(e), LV_STATE_CHECKED);
    lcd349_kv_set_blob("setup", "sound", &on, 1);
}

lv_obj_t *setup_create(lv_obj_t *parent, lv_event_cb_t on_done, void *ctx)
{
    lv_obj_t *panel = ui_panel(parent, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);
    setup_t *s = lv_malloc_zeroed(sizeof *s);
    s->brightness = lcd349_backlight_get();
    lv_obj_set_user_data(panel, s);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(panel, setup_free, LV_EVENT_DELETE, s);
    const int top = UI_PAD + lv_font_get_line_height(UI_FONT) + 6;

    lv_obj_t *l = ui_label(panel, "Brightness", UI_FONT, UI_MUTED);
    lv_obj_set_pos(l, UI_PAD, UI_PAD);
    lv_obj_t *minus = ui_button(panel, LV_SYMBOL_MINUS, UI_TARGET + 8, UI_TARGET + 8, brightness_down, s);
    lv_obj_set_pos(minus, UI_PAD, top);
    s->value = ui_label(panel, "", UI_FONT_LARGE, UI_TEXT);
    lv_obj_set_width(s->value, 72);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_align(s->value, LV_TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 0);
    lv_obj_align_to(s->value, minus, LV_ALIGN_OUT_RIGHT_MID, 4, 0);
    lv_obj_t *plus = ui_button(panel, LV_SYMBOL_PLUS, UI_TARGET + 8, UI_TARGET + 8, brightness_up, s);
    lv_obj_align_to(plus, s->value, LV_ALIGN_OUT_RIGHT_MID, 4, 0);
    setup_show(s);

    lv_obj_t *sl = ui_label(panel, "Sound", UI_FONT, UI_MUTED);
    lv_obj_set_pos(sl, 300, UI_PAD);
    lv_obj_t *sw = lv_switch_create(panel);
    lv_obj_set_size(sw, 2 * UI_TARGET, UI_TARGET);
    lv_obj_set_pos(sw, 300, top + 4);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(sw, lv_color_hex(UI_GOOD), LV_PART_INDICATOR | LV_STATE_CHECKED);
    uint8_t on = 1;
    size_t len = 1;
    lcd349_kv_get_blob("setup", "sound", &on, &len);
    if (on) {
        lv_obj_add_state(sw, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
    }
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(sw, sound_changed, LV_EVENT_VALUE_CHANGED, NULL);

    lv_obj_t *done = ui_button(panel, LV_SYMBOL_OK " Done", 140, UI_BODY_H - 2 * UI_PAD, on_done, ctx);
    lv_obj_align(done, LV_ALIGN_RIGHT_MID, -UI_PAD, 0);
    return panel;
}
```

## The app loop

Button edges arrive on the kit's event task; queue them to your own task, classify them there, and handle the gestures with the LVGL lock held. The loop ticks every 20 ms so holds complete on time and the hold bar moves.

```c
static void on_button(const lcd349_btn_event_t *ev, void *ctx)
{
    (void)ctx;
    xQueueSend(s_buttons, ev, 0);
}

void app_main(void)
{
    s_buttons = xQueueCreate(16, sizeof(lcd349_btn_event_t));
    lcd349_err_t err = lcd349_init(NULL);
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "lcd349_init: %s, status 0x%03x", lcd349_err_str(err), (unsigned)lcd349_board_status());
    if (!lcd349_display()) {
        return;
    }
    uint8_t brightness;
    size_t len = 1;
    if (lcd349_kv_get_blob("setup", "brightness", &brightness, &len) == LCD349_OK) {
        lcd349_backlight_set(brightness);
    }

    lcd349_ui_lock();
    lv_obj_t *scr = lv_screen_active();
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(scr, lv_color_hex(UI_BG), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(scr, LV_OPA_COVER, 0);
    lv_obj_set_scrollable(scr, false);
    s_status = status_bar_create(scr, "");
    s_body = ui_panel(scr, LCD349_LCD_W, UI_BODY_H, UI_BG);
    lv_obj_set_pos(s_body, 0, UI_STATUS_H);
    show(PAGE_LIST);
    lv_timer_create(tick_status, 1000, NULL);
    lcd349_ui_unlock();
    lcd349_buttons_subscribe(on_button, NULL);

    lcd349_classifier_t cls;
    lcd349_classifier_cfg_t cfg = {.hold_ms = {1000}, .chord_window_ms = 150};
    lcd349_classifier_init(&cls, &cfg);
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "ready");

    for (;;) {
        lcd349_gesture_t g[LCD349_CLASSIFIER_MAX_OUT];
        size_t n;
        lcd349_btn_event_t ev;
        if (xQueueReceive(s_buttons, &ev, pdMS_TO_TICKS(20)) == pdTRUE) {
            n = lcd349_classifier_feed(&cls, &ev, g, LCD349_CLASSIFIER_MAX_OUT);
        } else {
            n = lcd349_classifier_tick(&cls, lcd349_time_ms(), g, LCD349_CLASSIFIER_MAX_OUT);
        }
        lcd349_ui_lock();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            on_gesture(&g[i]);
        }
        if (s_page == PAGE_HOLD) {
            hold_progress(s_view, lcd349_classifier_hold_permille(&cls, LCD349_BTN_BOOT, lcd349_time_ms()));
        }
        lcd349_ui_unlock();
    }
}
```
